revisionLog.change: Replaced the impractical zero-reconnect scientific requirement with frozen coverage rules: reconnect-spanning orders are discarded, fresh snapshots must restore the book, connected-time coverage must be at least 98%, no disconnect may exceed five minutes, and any detected forward level2 sequence gap blocks scientific classification.

Changed data acquisition to one independent public WebSocket/recording per product, following Coinbase guidance to spread high-volume subscriptions across connections. The hypothetical placement, queue, fill, TTL, notional and markout rules are unchanged.

purpose: Measure whether post-only maker execution can reduce MoneyMog implementation cost after fill probability, queue competition, spread capture, and adverse selection. This is execution research, not alpha research and not a change to frozen crypto v2.

venue.name: Coinbase Advanced Trade
venue.connectionArchitecture: one independent WebSocket and raw recording per product

recording.reconnectPolicy: A reconnect does not invalidate the whole product recording by itself. All open hypothetical orders spanning the disconnect are marked DATA_GAP and excluded. No new order may be placed until a fresh level2 snapshot reconstructs that product book.
recording.notes: A one-hour run is only an engineering check. The first scientific report requires three concurrent product recordings, each covering at least seven calendar days, at least 98% connected-time coverage, no single disconnect longer than five minutes, zero parse errors, and zero detected forward level2 sequence gaps.

hypotheticalOrders.limitPriceRule: BUY joins the current best bid; SELL joins the current best ask; never cross the spread
hypotheticalOrders.queueRule: assume the hypothetical order joins the back of the displayed queue at the selected price
hypotheticalOrders.fillRule: fill only after observed same-price market-trade volume on the maker side consumes queueAhead plus hypothetical order size, or when an observed trade prints strictly through the resting limit price; cancellations ahead are not credited
hypotheticalOrders.reasonForConservatism: Ignoring queue-ahead cancellations understates fill probability rather than inventing fills. A later queue model may only be introduced under a new execution experiment ID.

markouts.reference: midpoint of best bid/ask from synchronized level2 book
markouts.signConvention: positive means price moved in favor of the maker order after fill

costComparison.feeTierAssumption: Coinbase Exchange lowest published volume tier; report separately from account-specific realized Advanced fees

antiSelectionRule: Do not choose a favorable product, side, notional, time-of-day, or market regime after viewing results and call it the primary execution policy. Any deployment-oriented execution rule must be frozen under a new numbered execution experiment and evaluated forward.
